copy.intro: Two seats, a turbo V8 and a convertible body in black. Built for dry summer days and scenic drives with one passenger.
good_for: Scenic routes out of the city

faq.question: How many people can ride in the AMG GT C?
faq.answer: Two. It has 2 seats and 2 doors, so it suits a couple or a solo driver with light luggage.

faq.question: Is it rear-wheel drive or all-wheel drive?
faq.answer: Rear-wheel drive, so it is best on dry roads. Pick a different car from our fleet for snowy weeks.

faq.question: What kind of engine does it have?
faq.answer: A 4.0 L turbocharged V8 that runs on gas.

faq.question: Can it be delivered to me?
faq.answer: You can collect it from us or have it delivered to your address. The delivery fee is shown on the booking page.

faq.question: How many seats does the A220 have?
faq.answer: Five seats and four doors, enough for a small group or a family.

faq.question: Which driver aids does it have?
faq.answer: Adaptive cruise control and automatic emergency braking, plus a backup camera for parking.

faq.question: Is the engine turbocharged?
faq.answer: Yes. It is a 2.0 L four cylinder with a turbocharger, and it runs on gas.

faq.question: How many kilometres are included each day?
faq.answer: 200 km a day are included in the rental price, so plan longer trips with that in mind.

copy.intro: A white CLA sedan with a dual-clutch automatic, a turbo engine and adaptive cruise control. Four doors, five seats, a sloping roofline.

faq.question: What kind of transmission does the CLA250 have?
faq.answer: It is an automatic, a dual-clutch type, so there is no clutch pedal to manage in traffic.

faq.question: Does it have a backup camera?
faq.answer: Yes. A backup camera is listed in its equipment, along with automatic emergency braking.

faq.question: Can four adults ride in the back and front?
faq.answer: It has 5 seats and 4 doors, so a group of adults can travel together.

faq.question: What do I need to pick it up?
faq.answer: Bring an Ontario G or G2 licence and a credit card in your name. We check your licence and identity before pickup.
